profile.headline: TS/SCI with FSP
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the military industry. Skilled in Python and mobile developments techniques. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's Degree focused in Computer Engineering from Polytechnic University of Puerto Rico.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Responsible for performing vulnerability assessments on closed-circuit TV system, analyzing   and reverse engineering code as necessary with the use of open source tools.
· Architected and developed a researched proof of concept to exploit closed-circuit TV system communications by creating a network stack framework that allows packet injection and inspection for man in the middle attacks.
· Engineering, developed and deployed web applications at all layers from database to user interfaces.
· Applied data mining, cleaning and munging for exploratory analysis to identifies trends.
· Used rapid development techniques for prototyping ideas predicting binary classification problems.
· Developed quality assurance automation scripts for daily uses.
· Valued member of a collaborative programming team. Demonstrated ability to expand and develop cross platform tools.
· Regularity met with customers to gather project requirement, specifications and feedback.
· Maintained and enhanced front and back end applications using Java and ExtJS.
· Conduct Information assurance risk and vulnerability assessments. Identifies weaknesses and provide recommendations for improvements.

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
•	Used native Objective-C and Java to develop IVULoto mobile applications for iOS and Android.
•	Involved at every project phase, from concept creation to app store deployment.
•	Responsible for general maintenance of application library and debugging.
•	Assisted in designing the User Interface and overall look and feel of the app.
•	Responsible for consuming the REST services, getting JSON response and parsing them to get the required information. 
•	Design and implement database. 
•	Work closely with the web service development team to ensure proper integration between mobile application and web service.

positions.title: Cooperative Education Student
positions.description:
Web Development
 
●	Developed and maintenance the front end and back end of on-going client web application using    JSP, HTML, CSS, Java, Javascript and MySQL.
●	Used Jquery to enhance functionality.
●	Discovered and fixed bugs by inspection. Either fixed bugs by myself or assisted in fixing them.
●	Build a perl web client script that parse raw data from HTML format and write it into a text file.

Software Development 

●	Developed scripts and procedures for analyst process automation.
●	Developed tool using python that process unstructured text file or spreadsheet and parse the data, following a report format which allow just ASCII text.
●	Assisted integrating tool into a different software application using frameworks.

Research Development Team 

●	Responsible for a variety of task including researching, front-end development, back-end development, testing, troubleshooting and designing user interface.
●	Build web application cloud-hosted which optimize tasks avoiding the uses of spreadsheet to eliminate typos having a user friendly interface which it’s auto generated by the system depending on the task. 
●	Developed front end web application creating a rich graphical user interface using the web framework ZK (Ajax web application framework written in java).
●	Developed back end using MySQL and Accumulo.
●	Developed and maintenance front end and back end of on going web application using Django, Jquery UI, Jgrowl and MySQL.
●	Used multithreading to enhance performance and efficiency.
